Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly instructed to treat the Łódź Film School/Łódź Film Academy as part of the University of Łódź. This is factually wrong—PWSFTviT (Łódź Film School) is a separate institution, not a faculty of the University of Łódź. This conflation could lead to an incorrect final answer about where the director studied.
